description: Canonical feature registry for the EWS dropout prediction model. All features must appear in this exact order during both training and inference.

features.name: attendance_rate
features.description: Student attendance as a percentage (0-100). Derived from sessions attended / total sessions.

features.name: avg_quiz_score
features.description: Average quiz score across all graded quizzes in the trimester, normalised to 0-100.

features.name: assignment_avg
features.description: Average assignment score across all submissions in the trimester, normalised to 0-100.

features.name: exam_score
features.description: Final or midterm exam score, normalised to 0-100. May be NaN if no exam recorded.

features.name: num_logins
features.description: Total platform login count for the trimester.

features.name: time_spent_minutes
features.description: Total minutes spent on the platform during the trimester.

features.name: content_completed
features.description: Number of content items (modules, videos, readings) completed.

features.name: content_completion_rate
features.description: Percentage of required content items completed (content_completed / content_required * 100).

features.name: quiz_attempts
features.description: Total number of quiz attempts made (includes retakes).

features.name: discussion_posts
features.description: Number of discussion forum posts created.

features.name: submission_delay_avg
features.description: Proportion of assignments submitted late (proxy for procrastination index).

features.name: engagement_frequency
features.description: Fraction of weeks with non-zero engagement activity (0=never active, 1=every week).

features.name: engagement_decay
features.description: Ratio of last week activity to first week activity. < 1 means declining engagement.

features.name: activity_variance
features.description: Variance of weekly activity levels. High variance indicates inconsistent engagement.

features.name: performance_trend
features.description: Linear regression slope over [attendance_rate, avg_quiz_score, assignment_avg]. Positive = improving.

target.name: is_dropout
target.description: Binary dropout risk label. 1 = at-risk / dropped out, 0 = retained. Ground truth from institution.
